cards.title: Markets move in waves
cards.body: Even strong markets fall 10–20% sometimes. In March 2020 the Nifty fell about 38% in a few weeks, then got back above its old high by the end of that year.

cards.title: Time is your superpower
cards.body: Money you won't need for 5+ years can ride out dips. Money for next month's rent shouldn't be in stocks.

cards.title: Dips can actually help a SIP
cards.body: Your fixed amount buys more units when prices are low. That's why stopping a SIP during a fall often hurts more than the fall itself.

cards.title: No one can predict the market
cards.body: Not finfluencers, not apps, not us. Be wary of anyone promising guaranteed or "sure-shot" [[returns|returns]].

cards.question: Your SIP is down 8% this month and you need the money in 6 years. What's sensible?
options: Move everything into one hot stock
cards.explanation: With a long horizon, short dips are normal. Staying consistent is what builds wealth.
